payout_quote: Indiana taxpayers are eligible for a state income tax credit of 20% of contributions to an Indiana529 Direct Savings Plan account, up to $1,500 credit per year ($750 for married couples filing separately).
steps: Open an Indiana529 account online (minimum $10 to start).
Contribute to the account during the calendar tax year.
Claim the 20% credit on your Indiana state income tax return (up to $1,500 per year; $750 if married filing separately).
Keep the funds for qualified education expenses to avoid credit recapture.
catches: A nonrefundable state tax credit, not cash: it only saves money if you owe Indiana income tax; contribute $0 or owe $0 in Indiana tax and you get $0.
Must be an Indiana taxpayer (resident or non-resident) contributing to an Indiana529 account.

The credit may be recaptured from the account owner for rollovers to another state's 529 plan, federal non-qualified withdrawals, out-of-Indiana K-12 tuition withdrawals, education loan repayments, or Roth IRA rollovers.
Non-qualified withdrawals: earnings face federal income tax plus a 10% federal penalty tax, plus state and local income taxes - consult a tax professional.
The official footnote ties the stated credit terms to the Indiana529 Direct Savings Plan; confirm advisor-sold or CD plan treatment in the Disclosure Booklet.
biggest_catch: It is a nonrefundable Indiana tax credit, not cash in hand: it only reduces Indiana income tax you actually owe, and the state can recapture the credit if you roll the account to another state's plan or take a non-qualified withdrawal.
eligibility: Indiana taxpayer (resident or non-resident, individual or married) who contributes to an Indiana529 account.
timing: Annual cycle: contribute during the calendar tax year, then claim the credit when filing that year's Indiana income tax return.
payout_value_note: 20% of contributions (up to $7,500/yr) = max $1,500/yr credit; nonrefundable Indiana tax credit, not cash.
numeric_basis: payout from official terms (20% credit up to $1,500/yr); time: online account opening + claiming the credit on the state tax return, est. 20-40 min active.
